title: Whirliness beyond amenability
summary: Given a non-atomic standard probability space $(Ω,μ)$, we exhibit examples of non-amenable closed topological subgroups of $\mathrm{Aut}(Ω,μ)$ whose natural near-action on $(Ω,μ)$ is whirly. This answers a 2010 question by Pestov in the negative. The argument proceeds via constructing Gaussian near-actions from topologically faithful unitary representations of non-amenable whirly Polish groups.
